sampler: Optuna TPESampler (Bayesian Tree-structured Parzen Estimator, seed=42)
objective: Maximize 5-fold Group-CV Candidate Macro F1-score on the 80 training trips

learning_rate.rationale: Controls shrinkage per boosting stage vs generalization.

max_leaf_nodes.rationale: Controls interaction depth and tree complexity.

min_samples_leaf.rationale: Regularizes leaf support to prevent overfitting to specific trips.

l2_regularization.rationale: Shrinks leaf weights and improves probability calibration (log-loss).

max_bins.rationale: Histogram discretization resolution for distance/heading thresholds.

max_iter.rationale: Upper bound on boosting rounds (with early stopping enabled).
